senses.gloss: to divide.—Part. pass. מְסַפַּק, מְסַפְּקָא divided in opinion, doubtful, questionable.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Lamentations 5:3">Targ. Lam. V, 3</cite> <he>מס׳ להון</he> they are in doubt.—
<cite ref="Beitzah 4b:8">Bets. 4ᵇ</cite> <he>ר׳ אסי סַפּוּקֵי מס׳ ליה</he> R. A. was undecided in his opinion.
<cite ref="Pesachim 117a:21">Pes. 117ᵃ</cite> <he>אלמא מס׳ ליה</he> which proves that he was undecided; a. fr.—Hence:

senses.gloss: to create a doubt, make doubtful, treat as doubtful.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 39a:2">Kidd. 39ᵃ</cite> (ref. to doubtful ‘Orlah fruit outside of Palestine) <he>סַפֵּק לי וכ׳</he> make them doubtful for me (pluck them in my absence), and I shall eat them.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 39a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>מְסַפְּקוּ סַפּוּקֵי להדדי</he> they made (the fruit) doubtful to one another (by exchanging fruit cut by the one in the absence of the other).
<cite ref="Bekhorot 49a:9">Bekh. 49ᵃ</cite> <he>מְסַפְּקִינָן ליה</he> we treat it as doubtful.
